response.justification: Strong, long-tenured individual contributor with 13+ years of software development and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth (built the Trial test runner and Fluent-Asserts libraries, worked on the LabWindows/CVI IDE, ran GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, taught Selenium and TDD courses). Mobile exposure exists via iOS/Apple TV app ownership and a mobile device orchestration tool. However, the resume shows no formal people-management experience — no manager title, no mention of direct reports, hiring, performance reviews, or one-on-ones — which is a hard minimum for this Level II Manager role. Technical leadership is implied by Staff Engineer titles and founding GISCollective, but organizational change leadership and team development are unevidenced. Worth a screening call to probe for informal leadership and management appetite, but the management gap likely disqualifies against candidates with 2+ years leading teams.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer tooling and test infrastructure experience (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, IDE work)
13+ years of broad engineering across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems
Proven knowledge-sharing and mentoring track record via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: No documented people management or direct-report experience against a 2-year minimum
No evidence of leading organizational change or owning a team roadmap
Mobile platform ecosystem exposure is dated (iOS work circa 2015-2016) and secondary

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and test infrastructure depth
